principle: A failed GNN health gate blocks unsafe serving, not the capability or its system-wide target role.
target_roles: entity resolution and duplicate candidate ranking
non_authority_rule: GNN output remains derived evidence/ranking signal; it never becomes canonical truth or sole action authority.

promotion_lanes.research_shadow: allowed with provenance and no production influence
promotion_lanes.production_reranking: blocked until non-collapse, quality, leakage, freshness and rollback evidence
promotion_lanes.autonomous_action: blocked until owner-gated multi-signal policy and rollback evidence

required_health_gates: explicit abstention threshold and fail-safe behavior
next_action: repair/retrain/evaluate GNN as a bounded system-wide derived capability; do not reduce it to research-only and do not promote current collapsed output
